title: Page 54
transc:
12 M
Hd Qrs AP Washn 11 45 am Sept. 11 62
For Vernon Seth Williams By
direction of the Vermin in
Chief a Raven McManns of 
Bolivia's Corps was sent yesterday
Evening to the Relay House
to report to the commanding
Officer there Vernon Casey is
ordered this morning to send
two additional Stanhopes to Vernon
Abercrombie Arrivals yesterday eleventh Cognac
assigned to Haskin one hundred
& thirtieth <insertion>(30th)</insertion> New York for
Vermin Adorn one hundred &
nineteenth <insertion>(119) </insertion> New York assigned to
Haskin & thirty seventh  <insertion>37 </insertion> Columbia
Weber's Raleigh & the fifth
Census couldn't get Stomach & 
Wedge last night but promise
to march this morning I
will have them hurried up
Venus Sawtelle says Yancey has
moved signed Richd B Irwin
Capt ADC End
